name: GM - Bedford Casting Operations, Bedford IN

fieldNotes.site: GM Bedford Casting Operations, 105 GM Dr, Bedford (Shawswick Twp, Lawrence County) IN 47421. Positively confirmed: Street View (2026-04) on the east perimeter road shows the GM logo on the administration building facade plus a 'Bedford Casting Operations' GM monument sign with US/Indiana flags; foundry smokestacks and two water towers are visible from multiple angles. Roster/address geocode (38.8795,-86.4851) lands on a large interconnected multi-roof casting complex. ~1M sq ft aluminum die-casting foundry on ~152.5 acres straddling GM Drive; ~680-900 workers; casts cylinder blocks, transmission cases, structural and EV drive-unit housings.
fieldNotes.type: Aluminum die-casting foundry, not a distribution warehouse - inbound aluminum/ingot/scrap and outbound castings to GM powertrain/assembly plants. Freight is handled through internal material bays plus an outdoor laydown/container/scrap yard rather than a long warehouse dock bank.
fieldNotes.truckGate: True - the property is fully chain-link fenced (confirmed in Street View along the east perimeter road). A controlled fenced truck/material gate with a small canopy structure is visible on the southeast perimeter (~38.8778,-86.4823); trucks enter the fenced yard at a controlled pinch point. Banded as a true gate.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Marked false / remoteGs true at medium confidence - no clearly staffed multi-window guard booth could be positively resolved at the truck gate; the visible checkpoint reads as a gated/kiosk-style control. A foundry of this scale may run a staffed gatehouse, so flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: True - inside the fence there is open paved/gravel yard and a material laydown area between the main plant and the south warehouse where inbound trucks can hold before backing to bays.
fieldNotes.drivewayShort: True - the gate-to-building approach is short (1-2 trucks); the fenced yard is compact and abuts the buildings, not a long deep approach.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Estimated 0-10 truck-serving dock doors - this is a foundry with a continuous-roof manufacturing complex, not a multi-bay DC; overhead imagery shows few discrete dock positions, mostly material handling at the SE/SW building faces. Flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.dropArea: A modest trailer/container drop-and-storage area sits on the west/southwest yard between the main plant and the south (1107) warehouse, with stacked containers and a row of trailers (~10 visible). Banded 10-25; dropYard true. Capacity ~25 estimated, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: 3 - the main interconnected casting complex (counted as one), the detached east administration/office building, and the large detached south metal-clad warehouse ('1107', visible in Street View with concrete barrier blocks). Not classified as a multi-building campus (multipleFacilities false) since the casting complex dominates.
fieldNotes.railServed: Marked false - no active rail spur clearly running into the fenced property was resolved; an old limestone-era rail corridor and a long covered conveyor/pipe bridge cross the SE area but read as utility/process infrastructure, not a freight rail spur. Inbound aluminum appears to arrive by truck. Medium confidence.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Rural - the plant sits on the northwest edge of Bedford (pop. ~13k small town), bordered by a residential neighborhood to the west and open farmland/quarry land to the north and east. Per rubric, small-town edge industrial = Rural.
fieldNotes.scale: Not positively resolved; left false. A canopy/checkpoint structure exists at the SE gate but no clear weigh platform was confirmed.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: False - the single controlled gate and compact fenced yard offer little unused paved width for a dedicated express/bypass lane.

citations.claim: GM invests $45M at Bedford Casting Operations to expand EV drive-unit casting capacity; ~680 workers produce cylinder blocks, transmission cases, structural and drive-unit housings

verification.rationale: New GM-operated aluminum die-casting foundry; recent EV drive-unit investments ($45M 2022, $51M 2021, $456M+ since 2011) and GM signage/monument confirmed in 2026-04 Street View. Not a divested or RACER site.
